description: Evaluate ordered progression observations only after level identity, entry, completion and churn windows are explicit.

guide.applicability: Use for a bounded progression range with reviewed event and cohort semantics.
guide.context_boundary: A level with fewer returned completions is not automatically difficult or causal; missing exposure and eligibility stop that claim.
steps: Resolve level identity, exposure, entry, completion, retry and churn-window semantics.
Apply a reviewed funnel-diagnosis Operator to governed returned progression steps.
Report returned loss points, excluded cohorts and hypotheses without attributing player intent or design causality.
guide.title: Level progression loss diagnosis

summary: Locate returned progression loss under a project-defined level and churn contract.
